ops.title: P5 Rust CLI: documented warts and accepted divergences vs the click CLI
ops.body:
All 23 golden cases byte-match (stdout+stderr+exit code) — none of these warts needed a golden exemption. They are behavior-level divergences from cli.py, deliberate and documented:

1. --poll rejects negatives/non-numbers with a clean clap error (exit 2); click accepted negatives and slept on them. Pinned by tests/test_watch.py::test_watch_rejects_a_negative_poll_cleanly.
2. --version prints clap's `cc-transcript X.Y.Z` (click: `cc-transcript, version X.Y.Z`); the version is read from pyproject.toml at compile time.
3. clap parsing errors (unknown flag, missing required option, bad choice) render in clap's format, exit 2. App-level usage errors (invalid --session/--range/--since/--until, --head/--tail/--range mutual exclusion, digest stdin JSON, corrections query selector, missing file args) reproduce click's UsageError shape byte-for-byte — golden-pinned where covered (scratchpad_invalid).
4. Numeric options (--limit, --head, --tail, --width, --max-matches, -C) are unsigned at the parser: negatives get a clean clap rejection; click accepted e.g. negative --limit/--width with Python slicing semantics.
5. grep runs the Rust regex dialect (no lookaround; \w/\s/\b class differences per the d458ca8 pin convention). Invalid patterns keep the click-shaped "invalid pattern: …" usage error with the Rust engine's message text.
6. slice --since/--until: chrono RFC 3339 plus explicit naive-format detection. Exotic fromisoformat forms (space separator, date-only) now report "expected an RFC 3339 timestamp"/"requires a UTC offset" rather than parsing.
7. Engine/JSON errors (corrections, digest rows) render as one-line `Error: …` exit 1 instead of Python tracebacks. corrections sql renders BLOB cells as lossy-UTF-8 strings (orjson raised TypeError).
8. python -m cc_transcript is gone with __main__.py; entry points are the console script and uvx. docs/guide/06 re-pointed.
9. SIGINT outside watch exits 130 via the Rust ctrlc handler (click printed "Aborted!" and exited 1). watch drains and exits 0, unchanged.
10. Plan wart "uniform --json": already uniform — all eight report commands + watch carry --json with click-identical semantics; no change was needed.
11. Plan wart "unified width detection": interpreted as keeping the fixed 100-char defaults everywhere with NO terminal sniffing (deterministic output for agent consumers). Flagged to the orchestrator for review — the plan wording was ambiguous.
